thesis: SK hynix's HBM leadership and net-cash balance sheet should sustain above-cost-of-capital returns through the AI memory cycle, and the stock trades at a discount to memory peers on earnings and cash flow.
reason: Quality, net cash and a peer discount justify owning it. But earnings sit on peak-cycle margins, EV/Sales and P/B are above their 5-year highs, and beta is 2.39. Normalised earnings could be far lower. A 3% starter caps the cyclical downside. The portfolio is all cash, so no limits bind.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 40%, a sign the HBM/DRAM pricing premium is eroding back toward the commodity pattern.
ROIC falls below 15%, losing the cushion above the cost of capital that sets this cycle apart from the FY2022-23 trough.
FCF margin turns negative, repeating the FY2022-23 pattern of capex outrunning cash generation in an oversupplied market.
Net debt/EBITDA (ratios page) rises back above 1.0x, signalling a return to last cycle's leverage build-up.
